# 📌 Project Overview

This project focuses on analyzing movie industry data using:

- Python
- Pandas
- Plotly Express
- Dash

The goal is to transform a movie dataset into interactive visualizations
and build a dynamic analytics dashboard for exploring movie performance,
financial success, and industry trends.


# 🎯 Project Objectives

The project analyzes:

- 🎭 Movie distribution by genre
- ⭐ Average movie scores
- 💰 Budget vs gross revenue relationship
- 📅 Movie production trends over time
- 🏆 Highest grossing movies
- 🎬 Rating and genre patterns
